verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS compliance and security platform, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. Probes found no such docs: llms.txt and the markdown docs path both returned 404. The documented MCP server and service keys belong to a different story (agent connectivity) and do not count as agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
